name: braids
description: Find the reasoning in your past Claude Code sessions, and carry on from it.

plugins.name: braids
plugins.description: Search every Claude Code conversation on this machine, read the turns around what you find, and branch a new conversation from that exact point. Teaches Claude when to reach for your history and, as importantly, when not to. Reads the transcripts Claude Code already writes; never talks to a model and makes no network calls. Needs the braids binary: curl -fsSL https://braids.chat/install.sh | sh
